title: Groups

detail.noExpensesDescription: Add an expense to get started.
detail.venmoPaidDescription: If you sent {name} {amount}, record the payment so the group's balances show it.
detail.notFoundDescription: This group doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.
detail.archivedMessage: This group is archived. Expenses can't be added or changed, and payments can't be recorded, until it's unarchived.
detail.askToUnarchive: Ask a group owner or admin to unarchive it.
detail.deleteReceiptDescription: Its items and photo are deleted too. This can't be undone.

settings.title: Group Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.currencyChangeWarning: Changing currency only affects future expenses. Existing expenses will keep their original conversion rates.
settings.deleteConfirmDescription: Its expenses, payments, receipts and placeholder members are deleted for everyone in it. This can't be undone.
settings.archivedOn: Archived on {date}. Expenses can't be added or changed, and payments can't be recorded, until it's unarchived.
settings.addMemberDescription: Add someone to the group who doesn't have an account yet. They can be assigned expenses and will show up in splits. If they sign up later, their data can be merged into their real account.
settings.placeholderNameTaken: Someone in this group is already called {name}.
settings.removeDescription: {name} will be taken off this group. Someone who is in an expense or payment here can't be removed until they're taken out of it.
settings.archiveDescription: Archive this group to hide it from your dashboard. Everyone must be settled up first. You can unarchive it at any time.
settings.archiveConfirmDescription: It's hidden from your dashboard, and nobody can add expenses or payments to it until it's unarchived. Everyone must be settled up first.
settings.deleteDescription: Deleting a group removes all expenses, settlements, and member data permanently.
settings.leaveDescription: Leave this group. Your expenses and payments in it stay, and you'll need a new invite to rejoin. Settle up first.
settings.leaveConfirmDescription: You'll stop seeing it, and you'll need a new invite to rejoin. Your expenses and payments in it stay.
settings.transferDescription: Hand this group to another member. You'll become a regular member, and can then leave it.
settings.transferNoCandidates: Nobody else in this group has an account yet, so there's nobody to hand it to. Placeholder members can't own a group.

settle.title: Record a payment
settle.description: Record a payment between two group members.
settle.samePerson: From and To must be different people.

invite.title: Invite to group
invite.description: Generate an invite link to share with friends. Links expire after 7 days.
invite.linkInfo: Anyone with this link can join the group.
invite.claimDescription: When {name} accepts this link, the expenses and payments recorded for them become theirs. Links expire after 7 days.
invite.claimLinkInfo: Send this only to {name}: whoever accepts it first takes over their expenses and payments.

merge.title: Merge {name} into a member
merge.description: If {name} already joined this group with an account, move everything recorded for {name} to that account.
merge.confirm: {name}'s expenses, shares and payments will move to {member}, and {name} will be removed from the group. This can't be undone.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: The new owner can manage and delete this group. You'll become a regular member, and only they can give it back.
transfer.confirm: {name} will own this group, and you'll become a regular member.

emptyDescription: Create your first group to start splitting expenses with friends.

list.subtitle: Manage your shared expenses
list.noGroupsDescription: Create a group to start splitting expenses with friends.

payments.title: Payments
payments.deleteLabel: Delete the payment of {amount} from {from} to {to}
payments.deleteDescription: {from} paid {to} {amount} on {date}. Deleting it puts the balances back as if it had never been recorded.
